📱 STEP 3: Quick replies
Settings → Business tools → Quick replies → + (Add)
Har ek ke liye: 'Shortcut' mein naam likho (jaise sample), 'Message' mein neeche wala text paste karo. Jahan photo likha hai, wo photo bhi attach karo (photos neeche hain).
Chat mein / likhte hi ye sab aa jayenge.

Shortcut: sample
(Photo attach: sample poster B)
Ye rahe 2 options. "1" ya "2" likh ke bhejiye, saath mein naam, poora address aur pincode. Phir UPI ID bhejenge.
Payment is UPI pe kar dijiye: [UPI ID] (naam: [account name]). Payment ka screenshot yahin bhej dijiye.
Payment mil gaya, dhanyavaad 🙏 24 ghante mein dispatch karenge. Tracking ID yahin bhejenge.
Aapka parcel nikal gaya ✅ Courier: [courier] · Tracking: ____ · 3–7 din mein pahunch jayega.
Rate ₹3,500 + GST per sheet (8×4 ft, 12 mm). Har dhalai sirf ~₹88, ply ka ~₹416. Kitna area, kaunsa kaam (slab/column) aur kaunsa sheher? Hisaab bana ke bhejta hoon.
Asli site ke photos aur video: https://vajraformwork.vercel.app/photos
Sheet ka rate nahi, har dhalai ka kharcha dekhiye. Ply 4–6 baar chalti hai, VAJRA 40–50 baar. Aapka area bataiye, saal ka hisaab bana deta hoon.
Godown se video call pe stock dikha sakte hain. Kab free hain?
Dealer ke liye alag rate hai. Aapki shop kis sheher mein hai, aur mahine ka kitna kaam hota hai?
